summary: Haoxi Health Technology Ltd filed Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, reporting the closing of a registered direct offering. The company sold 9,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.25 per share and 16,999,998 pre-funded warrants exercisable for 176,034,979 Class A ordinary shares, raising gross proceeds of approximately $6.46 million before fees. The offering closed on May 12, 2026. The company agreed to a 30-day lock-up on further issuances and directors/officers/large shareholders entered 90-day lock-up agreements. Net proceeds will be used for working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
